text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City finishes running the Osaka Hai. 
Her performance drew awe from the crowd, 
yet an unsettled feeling lingered in Gold 
City's heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race,
the manager told Gold City 
that she was not beautiful right now,
that 
she was empty inside. Then, she suggested 
that Gold City quit running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the Trainer countered that she 
should keep running until she herself
said 
"I want to quit." Quitting now would only 
lead to regret—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City declared she would decide her 
own future. She set into motion to fill 
the void within herself before the Tenno 
Sho (Spring).
